quizName:
Hardest Questions in North dakota
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness can all impair your ability to drive.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers need to focus fully on the road. Any extra activity can be a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: You missed your exit on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway or shoulder. Instead, drive to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, your eyes off the road, or your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: When stopped by police, what documents must a driver show?
questions.explanation: Drivers must have and show their license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when stopped.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt?
questions.explanation: All drivers and front seat passengers must wear seat belts. Children under 18 must be properly fastened in a seat belt or child restraint system in any seat.

questions.question: When should you slow down while driving?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, near pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You feel angry after a work incident. What should you do before driving?

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Take time to calm down before driving if you are upset or angry. Driving while emotional is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your judgment, coordination, and reaction time. It also damages your vision and ability to judge distance. Even a small amount of alcohol can impair your driving.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What should you do when you see railroad tracks ahead?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate comes down.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Do not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means parking is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in a school zone unless posted otherwise?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a school zone is 20 miles per hour unless a different speed is posted. Always drive carefully in school zones.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry about it because all cars are the same.
Hide from your friend that you do not know the car.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, take time to find and understand the turn signals, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and check for traffic before proceeding. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for red or yellow lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal your intentions, even when no other cars are nearby.
Signal only if there are other cars nearby.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal your intentions, even when no other cars are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always use your signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Make signaling a habit every time, not just when you see other traffic.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This gives other drivers time to see your intention.
